metadata.description: Travel OS marketplace. Manages the existing Notion Travels & City database: nation and city reference pages filled to the template, trip itineraries assembled from email and calendar, pre-departure checks, the scheduled tasks behind them, database audits and the repairs they route. 6 skills: nation-city-pages, pre-departure-check, travel-db-audit, travel-db-repair, travel-scheduler, trip-itinerary. Proprietary and confidential, internal use only.

plugins.description: Travel operating system on top of the Notion Travels & City database: nation and city reference pages filled to the template, trip itineraries assembled from email and calendar, a pre-departure check, the scheduled tasks that keep those two running on time, a database audit that finds the defects and a repair skill that closes them. 6 skills: nation-city-pages, pre-departure-check, travel-db-audit, travel-db-repair, travel-scheduler, trip-itinerary.
